phase_name: End-to-End Verification Against the Observed Failing Case

objectives.description: Re-run fixed source-store script against the same repo/query as Phase 1, confirm exit 0 and non-empty output
Diff FIXED.out against BASELINE.out, confirm no modified shared lines
Confirm horty_2001_agency-and-deontic-logic is covered by a successful run
Confirm lit-coverage marker present and well-formed
Run a second, unrelated query to confirm the fix is not query-specific
Confirm .claude/scripts/literature-briefing.sh (this repo's deploy copy) was not modified

notes.harness: Re-used the Phase 1 scratch harness (mirrors the real per-repo .claude/scripts/ deploy layout), re-synced with the now-fixed source-store script content before this phase's run via `cp agent-system/extensions/literature/scripts/*.sh <fake-repo>/.claude/scripts/`; verified byte-identical to the fixed source-store file via diff -q before running.

notes.diff_vs_baseline: BASELINE.out was 0 bytes (Phase 1's authoritative scratch-harness run crashed at exit 141 before any output). diff BASELINE.out FIXED.out therefore shows only additions (238 lines, all new) and zero modified/removed shared lines -- satisfies bar #2 under the plan's explicit empty-baseline fallback clause ('If the Phase 1 baseline was empty because the script died immediately, record that and rely on the per-document selection argument plus the Phase 2 structural greps instead').
notes.horty_coverage: horty_2001_agency-and-deontic-logic resolved successfully as entry #48 of 52 in FIXED.out: 296 chunk(s), ~124241 tokens. This is the doc_id that triggered the crash in Phase 1's authoritative baseline run.
notes.deploy_copy_check: git status --short .claude/scripts/literature-briefing.sh (this repo) returns no output -- confirmed untouched throughout the task.
notes.all_bars_satisfied: Bar #1 (exit 0, non-empty): yes. Bar #2 (no modified shared lines vs baseline): yes, via empty-baseline fallback clause. Bar #3 (horty covered): yes. Bar #4 (head -1 audit closed): yes, in Phase 3.

deviations.description: Re-run the same command Phase 1 ran via `cd ~/Projects/Logos/Theory && bash <absolute source-store path> --query ...`
deviations.reason: Same root cause as Phase 1's deviation: literature-briefing.sh resolves PROJECT_ROOT from its own on-disk location, not $PWD, so the literal command never reaches repo mode when invoked by absolute path from outside the script's own directory tree. Re-used the Phase 1 scratch harness (re-synced with the fixed source-store content) to genuinely exercise the fix against the real observed sub-index and the real live global index.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — literal cd+absolute-path invocation does not reach repo mode; used the same scratch harness as Phase 1, re-synced with the fixed script, which correctly resolved and processed all 52 documents including horty_2001)*
